parameters.notes: Diode609. Each listed control was wheeled to both ends in the vendor panel and moved only its own byte; min/max are the raw limits seen. Raw units: no physical unit is claimed. Switches and selectors were clicked instead (2026-11-21); each changed only its own byte and min/max are the values seen; names and value meanings were read from the per-state pictures. Limit In / Compress In: 0 out, 1 in. Attack: 0 fast, 1 slow. Unmapped bytes are written back unchanged. Read layout on this device: loaded alone into an empty rack through this project's server, the cat 0x07 reply was one flag byte then the block and nothing else (one instance per reply)
